text.p: Bastia, down to 10 men for the last 20 minutes, missed the chance to move into second place in the French first division on Saturday when they lost 1-0 at Marseille.
Bastia, who had won seven of their last eight matches, had left-back Patrick Valery sent off in the 70th minute for a second bookable offence.
Victory would have taken them into second place above Paris St Germain. Former France striker Xavier Gravelaine scored on the stroke of halftime to enable Marseille to climb two places to ninth.
Fourth-placed Bordeaux scored three goals in the last five minutes, two of them in injury time, as they beat bottom club Nice 4-1 at home.
Leaders Monaco, four points ahead of PSG and six in front of Bastia, clash with the Parisian side at home on Sunday.
